channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Nikola Topic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Nikola Topic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Sam Presti on Nikola Topic
item.description:
Sam Presti on Nikola Topic:

“He’s had a difficult road. There’s no other way to look at it. He’s been unbelievable how he’s handled those things at his age.”

Sam Presti on Nikola Topic, Sep 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Chet Holmgren on Nikola Topic
item.description:
Chet Holmgren on Nikola Topic:

“I don’t ever want to say I can full comprehend or understand what he went through. With my situations, I was fighting to get back to my career. Anybody who is fighting cancer is fighting for their lives.. Speaks to the strength of Top.”

Chet Holmgren on Nikola Topic, Feb 12, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Nikola Topic
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Nikola Topic doing pregame warmups while still going through cancer treatment:

“He’s doing a great job navigating what’s obviously a tough circumstance. Despite the fact your body goes through hell in that situation, he’s still conditioning himself.”

Mark Daigneault on Nikola Topic, Dec 27, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Luguentz Dort on Nikola Topic
item.description:
Lu Dort on Nikola Topic:

“He's been doing a lot of his recovery stuff but you can see the talent and how much more comfortable with the ball. Recently, he started playing with us and be a little more active with us. He's still getting back from his injury but I can see just how comfortable with the ball and the type of player he's going to be.”

Luguentz Dort on Nikola Topic, Jun 1, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on Dillon Jones, Nikola Topic, Ajay Mitchell
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on Topic, Jones and Mitchell:

“These are three guys we have great confidence in. We’re really excited about them.”

Mark Daigneault on Dillon Jones, Nikola Topic, Ajay Mitchell, Jun 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, Nikola Topic
item.description:
Sam Presti on comparing Topić to Giddey:

“I wouldn’t compare him specifically to Josh or any other player.. Guys that are big for their position that process the game well… we value those skill sets.. I don’t think you have enough players who can make decisions on the court.”

Sam Presti on Josh Giddey, Nikola Topic, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Sam Presti on Nikola Topic
item.description:
Sam Presti:

“We're really excited about Nikola... It was a unique situation to get a player of that caliber... We're really excited to get to bring him into the organization.”

Sam Presti on Nikola Topic, Jun 27, 2024. Source: Twitter @CAlmanza1007.
